figurative_meaning_en: Showiness; only external pomp with an empty interior
similar_in_english: All that glitters is not gold
example_sentences_in_bangla: ওর বাড়িটা উপরে চিকণ চাকণ ভিতরে খেড়, বাইরে দেখতে সুন্দর কিন্তু ভিতরে কিছুই নেই।
এই রাজনীতিবিদরা সবাই উপরে চিকণ চাকণ ভিতরে খেড় প্রকারের লোক।
example_sentences_in_english: His house is all shiny on the outside but hollow inside, looks beautiful but has nothing within.
These politicians are all show on the surface but empty at the core.
history: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali observations of superficiality in rural or semi-urban life, with the variant possibly originating from older folk expressions about deceptive appearances.
note: The idiom emphasizes cultural critique of valuing looks over substance in Bengali society.
